name: valohai
description: Valohai agent skills for migrating Python ML projects and running Valohai workflows.

interface.longDescription: Help developers migrate Python ML projects to Valohai. Six skills cover valohai.yaml steps, configurable parameters, JSON metrics, managed inputs and outputs, project execution, and multi-step pipelines. The plugin provides instructions; running jobs requires a Valohai account and valohai-cli.
defaultPrompt: Help migrate this ML project to Valohai.
Create Valohai steps for this codebase.
Design a Valohai pipeline for this project.

review.commerce_description: This skills-only plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of six Valohai skills for migrating Python ML projects and designing Valohai workflows.
